records.description: The native optional unattended runner in modules/autopilot, driven through the adapter protocol by native_adapter.py.
records.equivalent: itself: the supported runner for this contract

records.description: The third-party control plane (a Node.js package with an embedded database) that the operator's experiments were built around.
requirements: network install from a package registry
evidence: provenance:operator control-plane experiment: plan binding/ownership runner
records.equivalent: the native autopilot; a third-party adapter can be trialled with conformance.py --adapter <absolute path> --allow-adapter once an operator has installed it

records.description: Isolation of the worker itself (not only of the Verify step) in an unattended run.
requirements: a sandbox with a network mode for the harness
records.blocker: harness needs network; sandbox.py has no network mode; orchestration outside the fence

records.description: A background plan runner that executes one round per scheduler tick.
requirements: a scheduler entry created by the operator
evidence: provenance:operator background plan runner (one round per tick)
records.equivalent: autopilot resume run by the operator's own scheduler; maintenance.py scheduler plan prints the unit or cron text without installing it

records.description: A report of the ready frontier of a plan pack.
records.equivalent: autopilot status --json lists done, pending and queued items from the same selection rule the runner uses

records.description: Running an item's Verify command in a fresh tree inside a sandbox.
A runner that binds a plan to a third-party control plane and records ownership there.
evidence: provenance:operator control-plane experiment: plan binding/ownership runner
records.equivalent: the native autopilot's persisted ownership: a flock plus an owner record with pid, start ticks and boot id

records.description: An installer for a pilot instance of the third-party control plane.
requirements: network install from a package registry
evidence: provenance:operator control-plane experiment: pilot instance installer
records.equivalent: modules/installer: a generic manifest-driven install with rollback; a pinned third-party package is described in PATTERNS.md, never executed

records.description: A network relay in front of a loopback-only instance of the third-party control plane.
evidence: provenance:operator control-plane experiment: network relay in front of a loopback-only instance
records.blocker: exposes a control plane on the network; outside the optional-adapter contract and excluded on purpose

records.description: A trusted pilot of the third-party control plane with its own authorisation reference.
records.blocker: depends on an authorisation reference specific to one operator and one control plane; nothing portable to ship

records.description: A process adapter that lets the third-party control plane start a runner under operator controls.
evidence: provenance:operator control-plane experiment: trusted runner (process adapter, operator controls)
records.equivalent: conformance.py accepts any adapter named by an absolute path; an empty slot reports every cell not-run

records.description: The launch entrypoint that starts a trusted run with an authorisation reference.
evidence: provenance:operator control-plane experiment: trusted launch entrypoint
records.blocker: an authorisation reference is not portable; native live kickoff uses a TTY plus a typed confirmation instead

records.description: The historical installer for the destructive-command guard.
records.equivalent: modules/installer: backup, hash, install and rollback as one pattern; guard integrity itself stays with the gates plugin

records.description: The historical installer for the sandbox package.
records.equivalent: sandbox.py probe plus the documented install line in the isolation README; no installer runs a package manager
